metadata.title: Grunge-Era Rock Album Cover with Stone Texture

retrievalProfile.description: A central photographic portrait framed by a heavy stone-textured border, featuring a crouching figure and high-contrast 90s rock typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition featuring a central high-key photograph of a crouching man with long hair, surrounded by a thick, tactile border of coarse, sun-bleached stones. The layout uses a jagged geometric logo in the top left and arched sans-serif text in the bottom right.
coreVisualRelationships: Central figure framed by a high-contrast stone texture border
Jagged red geometric icon overlapping the top-left corner of the inner frame
Arched typography following the curve of the figure's shadow in the bottom right
Warm sepia and cream tones contrasting with sharp black and red accents
coreInvariants: Thick border composed of large, rounded, textured stones
Central square photographic inset with a high-key, washed-out background
Crouching human subject as the primary focal point

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A man crouching in the center, occupying approximately 60% of the inner frame height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark silhouette of the crouching figure against the bright, sandy background.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the jagged logo top-left, moves down to the central figure, and follows the arched text in the bottom-right corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: High-key sandy ground within the inner frame provides breathing room for the dark subject.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm sepia and cream (background and stone texture)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black (subject's clothing and primary text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value in the center, medium value in the border, with high-contrast black elements for legibility.

letterConstructionRules: Minimalist, stencil-like gaps in some characters
characterSpecificRedesigns: R with a straight diagonal leg starting from the vertical stem
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-impact industrial display face paired with a clean, legible secondary face following a curved path.

preserve: Extreme horizontal expansion of main text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, wide, industrial feel of the primary display text.
Provides the necessary geometric squareness and weight.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a square image with a thick border of large, sun-bleached, textured stones. In the center, place a high-key, sepia-toned photograph of a man with long hair crouching on a sandy surface. Include a jagged red geometric icon in the top-left corner.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in a black, ultra-expanded geometric sans-serif font in the top-left, overlapping the red icon. Add secondary text in a white sans-serif font, arched along the bottom-right corner of the inner frame.

verificationChecks: Is the stone border thick and highly textured?
Is the main text extremely wide and heavy?
Is the secondary text following an upward arc in the bottom right?
Is the color palette restricted to sepia, cream, black, and red?

adjustableVariables: Complexity of the red geometric icon
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Exact shape of the red logo

mustAchieve: Balanced use of negative space in the center

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red icon is placed behind the main text.
Check that the stone border is not cropped out.
Verify the arched text is legible against the background.
Confirm the central figure is in a crouching pose.
recipe.reuseFormula: Stone-textured frame + high-key central portrait + ultra-wide industrial typography + arched secondary text.
